newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Spain gives Palestinians $50 million soft loan.
newsitem.headline: Spain gives Palestinians $50 million soft loan.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority signed a $50 million soft loan agreement with Spain on Wednesday to finance infrastructure projects, officials said.

They said Palestinian President Yasser Arafat attended the signing ceremony in Gaza between Palestinian Finance Minister Mohammed Zuhdi al-Nashashibi and Spanish Secretary of State for Trade and Tourism Jose Manuel Fernandez Norniella.
"His excellency and our finance minister signed this morning an agreement for a soft loan of $50 million for the Palestinian Authority," Arafat said after the signing.
Nashashibi said the easy term loan would be used to finance yet unspecified infrastructure projects.
